kebab_example: aliyun iot list-device-distribute-job --target-uid 198000 --current-page 1 --page-size 10 --status 1 --job-id UbmsMHmkqv0PiAG0000010001 --next-token TGlzdFJlc291000 --product-key a1T27vz0000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDeviceDistributeJob

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the destination account for device distribution
parameters.help_zh: 设备分发的目标阿里云账号ID
parameters.name: target_uid

parameters.help_en:
The page number to display from the returned results. Default value: 1.

NextToken and CurrentPage are conditional parameters for setting the display results. You can specify either one. If both are specified, NextToken takes priority.

For more information about how to use the NextToken parameter, see the NextToken description
parameters.help_zh:
指定从返回结果中的第几页开始显示。默认值是1。

NextToken与CurrentPage是设置显示结果的条件参数，可任选一个传入。如果同时传入，则NextToken优先级更高。

NextToken参数的使用说明，请参见NextToken描述
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of distribution tasks to display per page. Maximum value: 200
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示的分发任务数量。最大不超过200条
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The status of the device distribution task.

0: The task is being initialized.

1: The task is running.
 
2: The task is completed. This status only indicates that the distribution task has been executed. It does not indicate that all products and devices are distributed. To obtain the distribution result details, call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/199533.html.

3: The task is abnormally interrupted
parameters.help_zh:
设备分发任务的状态。

0：任务初始化。

1：任务执行中。
 
2：任务完成。该状态仅表示分发任务执行完成，不表示所有产品和设备都分发成功。获取分发结果详情，请调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/199533.html。

3：任务异常中断
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The ID of the device distribution task. This is the globally unique identifier of the task
parameters.help_zh: 设备分发任务的ID。任务的全局唯一标识符
parameters.name: job_id

parameters.help_en:
The token for the next page. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first query.

NextToken and CurrentPage are conditional parameters for setting the display results. You can specify either one. If both are specified, NextToken takes priority.

<notice>
The offset of query results is defined as: PageSize × (CurrentPage - 1).

If the offset is greater than 10,000, you must pass in the NextToken value returned by the previous call to this operation to retrieve Data. Otherwise, the request is interrupted and Data is not returned.

</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
下一页标识，首次查询无需传入。

NextToken与CurrentPage是设置显示结果的条件参数，可任选一个传入。如果同时传入，则NextToken优先级更高。

<notice>
定义查询结果的偏移数量为：PageSize×（CurrentPage-1）。

当偏移数量大于10,000时，必须传入上一次调用本接口返回的NextToken值，才会返回Data数据。否则，接口请求会被中断，无法返回Data数据。

</notice>
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs
parameters.name: product_key
